name: Local SEO Lesson - NAP Consistency and Map Embeds
body:
> Lesson · 2026-10-08

# Summary
A citation and NAP playbook built around paid LocalRank.so citations, tiered with cheap PBN posts that carry the NAP and a map embed, then local guest posts for competitive niches.

# Steps (as taught)
1. Buy LocalRank.so citations; wait 2 weeks.
2. Buy the "SuperBoost" citation tier; wait 2 weeks.
3. Tier the citations with PBN posts that link to them and include NAP, LocalBusiness schema and a Google Maps embed; wait 2 weeks.
4. Buy local guest posts carrying the NAP and map embed (competitive industries).
- Index everything; unindexed citations are said to be useless. Check with `site:` searches.
- If not in the map pack after 4 weeks, add more citations and PBN posts.
- Competitor check: search the #1 competitor's exact name in quotes; the result count hints at how many citations you need.
- Map embed comes from the GBP share button; LocalBusiness schema from a generator tool.

# TAG caution
PBN tiering is a link scheme. The citation, schema and map-embed parts are fine; the PBN parts are not used for TAG clients.

# How this applies to TAG clients
- Map embeds on contact pages and consistent NAP in schema match TAG practice; Summit city-service pages already emit Plumber schema through a mu-plugin.
- Before "fixing" NAP, confirm which numbers are intentional tracking numbers (Summit GHL DNI, Alphalete [WhatConverts](lib:brain-whatconverts)).
- Indexing checks run through [Google Search Console](lib:brain-google-search-console) and the [GSC Indexing Tracker](lib:brain-gsc-indexing-tracker).
